subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular `scripts/install.sh` architecture now, and must the public `openclaw.ai/install.sh` artifact remain a generated or preserved single-file entrypoint?
rationale: The request is maintainability cleanup on a stable setup surface where current docs, tests, release artifacts, and website sync assume one served shell script.

options.title: Sponsor a guarded split
options.body: Approve modular internals only with a preserved or generated single public installer plus aligned docs, workflow sync, ShellCheck, and installer smoke proof.

options.title: Extract only when bug-driven
options.body: Keep the issue as backlog guidance and extract sections only when tied to concrete installer bugs or validation improvements.

options.title: Keep the monolith
options.body: Decide the public shell installer should remain single-file to minimize helper-loading and packaging risk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a guarded split
recommendation.body: Approve modular internals only with a preserved or generated single public installer plus aligned docs, workflow sync, ShellCheck, and installer smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent repeated installer fixes and refactors make this the strongest available owner signal for deciding the split shape.
